sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Let's see what black children are
nodes = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
id_to_node = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
black = [n for n in nodes if n['color']=='B' and n['id']==3][0]
print('black children ids', black['children'])
for cid in black['children']:
    child = id_to_node[cid]
    print(' child', cid, 'color', child['color'], 'pixels', child['pixels'], 'hash', child['hash'])
# Also find top blue box id 15
top_blue = id_to_node[15]
print('top blue color', top_blue['color'], 'pixels', top_blue['pixels'], 'boundary', top_blue['boundary'])
# Check adjacency between orange and top blue
adj_set = set()
for a,bid in current_frame.segmentation['adjacency_list']:
    adj_set.add((a,bid))
    adj_set.add((bid,a))
orange_hash = 'eb4757350816e457'
blue_hash = '41da6ebe9dbaff59'
def find_node(h):
    for n in nodes:
        if n['hash']==h:
            return n
    return None
o = find_node(orange_hash)
b = find_node(blue_hash)
print('orange id', o['id'], 'blue id', b['id'])
print('orange adjacent to top blue?', (o['id'], top_blue['id']) in adj_set)
print('blue adjacent to top blue?', (b['id'], top_blue['id']) in adj_set)
# Check if moving UP once more will push orange into black box
# Let's try UP once and see
action(['UP'])
print('after UP board_changed', last_action_result['board_changed'], 'gameplay_changed', last_action_result['gameplay_changed'])
# Re-fetch nodes
nodes = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
id_to_node = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
blacks = [n for n in nodes if n['color']=='B' and n['pixels']>=30]
print('blacks count', len(blacks))
for bl in blacks:
    print('black id', bl['id'], 'pixels', bl['pixels'], 'children', bl['children'])
# Find orange
o = find_node(orange_hash)
print('orange boundary', o['boundary'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
